summary_en: BCPE Blitz Cayman (Bain Capital–LINE Yahoo partnership) will not increase tender price during 5-business-day window (closed 20 Aug 2026). BCPE Blitz tender: 3,520 yen/share (or 3,640 yen if KDDI non-tender agreement secured). Kamgras 1 competing bid: 3,570 yen/share (raised 13 Aug 2026). Board remains neutral; will evaluate both offers versus company value and feasibility.
title_en: Notice regarding progress of BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P. tender offer for the Company's shares
translation_en_brief: On 21 August 2026, Kakaku.com disclosed an update on the competing public tender offers for its shares. BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P.—a limited partnership formed by Bain Capital with indirect investment from LINE Yahoo Corporation—will not raise its tender price during the 5-business-day adjustment window that closed 20 August 2026. BCPE Blitz's current offer stands at 3,520 yen per share, or 3,640 yen per share if a non-tender agreement with KDDI is secured. This competes with the Kamgras 1 offer (backed by Oasis Management Company Ltd., a principal shareholder), which raised its bid to 3,570 yen per share on 13 August 2026. The company's board has previously expressed support for the Kamgras 1 offer but maintains a neutral position on shareholder participation, leaving the choice to shareholders. The board will now conduct a careful evaluation of both proposals against Kakaku.com's corporate value enhancement, shareholder interests, and execution feasibility. The two offers are mutually exclusive; the disclosure confirms that Oasis continues to support the BCPE Blitz proposal at 3,640 yen per share (conditional on KDDI cooperation) as preferable to lower bids.
